page_title: FRE 1-3 STU | Freiburg v Stuttgart 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Daniel Siebert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
90+9' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) for a tough tackle.
90+4' Alexander Nubel is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
90+2' Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
90' Today's referee Daniel Siebert rightly decides to book Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) for his harsh tackle.
88' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Freiburg is cautioned for aggressive play.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matthias Ginter as he is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
83' Substitution. Lucas Holer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
83' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
82' A substitution has been made. Maximilian Mittelstadt is replaced by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart).
80' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
77' Stuttgart concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
76' Here is a change. Enzo Millot is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart).
76' That will be all from Chris Fuhrich who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
74' 1 - 3 GOAL! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Noah Atubolu, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:3.
73' Substitution. Nicolas Hofler makes his way off the pitch and Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) comes on as his replacement.
73' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Jordy Makengo and he is replaced by Christian Gunter (Freiburg).
72' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
72' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
67' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
66' The attendance for today's match is 34700.
65' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
64' 3:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.

62' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Noah Atubolu!
55' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
53' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
52' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
50' The linesman signals a throw-in for Freiburg.
47' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+13' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+11' 1 - 2 Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top right corner. The score is 1:2.
45+11' The ball goes out of play and Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
45+6' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
45+4' The foul by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.
45' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
44' Freiburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
42' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Yellow card! It's like Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Daniel Siebert agrees and books him.
39' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

39' A snap shot by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu produces a good save to thwart him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
33' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Freiburg is cautioned for aggressive play.
26' Daniel Siebert interrupts the game. One of the players from Stuttgart won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
22' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
21' Christian Streich appears to have said too much and referee Daniel Siebert comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
18' The referee goes straight to his pocket and shows Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) a red card. No point in arguing. He has to leave the pitch.
17' A player from Freiburg commits a rough challenge. Daniel Siebert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
14' The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
12' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul after dangerous play. Freiburg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
7' 0 - 2 Goal! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
3' 0 - 1 Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
1' The first half has started.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will supervise the game today.
